title: In 1965, two astronauts played the first music in space, on a harmonica and bells. Which Christmas song?
alt: Printed copies of The Don't Die Retired Christmas Puzzle Book and the UK and American editions of the Christmas Quiz Book on a wooden table, beside the words: In 1965, two astronauts played the first music in space, on a harmonica and bells. Which Christmas song?

posts.facebook:
In 1965, two astronauts played the first music in space, on a harmonica and bells. Which Christmas song?

The answer is further down ↓

·
·
·

Answer: Jingle Bells. Tom Stafford and Wally Schirra, on Gemini 6, first radioed that they could see something like a satellite, as if Santa were flying past.

It's one of the 300 questions in our Christmas Quiz Book, in a UK and an American edition, on Amazon.
